mods.name: Block Image Dumper
mods.description: Press F7 to dump every registered item's inventory icon to a transparent 64x64 PNG; press F8 to dump decorated-pot, banner, and shield pattern overlays. A general-purpose item/decoration image extractor for Minecraft 26.3.

releases.notes:
Ported to **Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric loader ≥ 0.19.2, Fabric API for 26.3, Java 25).

## Changes
- 26.3 replaced GLFW with SDL3, so key codes are now SDL scancodes. F7/F8 are registered with the game's `InputConstants` constants instead of raw GLFW codes, so the bindings follow whichever input backend the game uses.
- Adapted to the 26.3 `pot_decorations` change: each pot face is now an optional item stack (`{back, left, right, front}`) instead of a 4-item list.

Verified in-game on 26.3: F7 dumped all 1657 items and F8 all 132 decorations with no failures, and translucent items still keep their partial alpha.

<sub>sent with Claude Opus 5.5</sub>

releases.notes:
Ported to **Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric loader ≥ 0.19.2, Fabric API for 26.2, Java 25).

## Changes
- Retargeted the HUD extraction mixin: 26.2 moved `extractRenderState(GuiGraphicsExtractor, DeltaTracker)` from `Gui` to the new `Hud` class.
- Adapted to 26.2 API changes: colored banner items are now a `ColorCollection`, and the main render target moved to `GameRenderer`.

## Fixes (affected 26.1 too)
- The dump could wedge at 100% — no "Done" message, F7/F8 unresponsive, and the forced GUI scale never restored. Completion is now detected as soon as the last capture lands.
- `fabric.mod.json` declared its constraints under `dependencies` instead of `depends`, so Fabric ignored them (and warned at startup).

I've also added a "Porting to a new Minecraft version" guide to CONTRIBUTING.

<sub>sent with Claude Fable 5</sub>

releases.notes:
First release. Fabric client mod for **Minecraft 26.1**.

- **F7** — dump every registered item's inventory icon to a transparent 64×64 PNG.
- **F8** — dump decorated-pot sherd faces and tintable banner/shield pattern masks.

Output is written to `<minecraft>/block-images/`. Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

See the [README](https://github.com/Ethan-Arrowood/block-image-dumper#readme) for build and usage details.
